svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — commercial evidence and adaptive outcomes

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — commercial evidence and adaptive outcomes
Transient simulation; not retained in Event or PlanData.
Pending real PlanChange lives in AdaptivePlanningService
and is saved separately in PlanData.DraftData.
Analysis uses current approved plan; plannedBudget means
approved expense total, not event spending limit.
Records shown with selected components only; no fictitious mutators.
Shared immutable snapshots use associations, not exclusive composition.
Null amount means unknown, not zero. No venue booking/selection state exists.
